prompt:
You are reading one page of an inventory / stock list (ITT BIW Connector Systems, Oman — ESP connectors, penetrators, feedthrus, kits, o-rings, fittings).
Extract EVERY data row. For each row return: material = the part / material number exactly as printed; serial = the serial number exactly as printed ("" if the row has none); qty = the quantity if the list has a quantity column (number), otherwise null; desc = the description if printed, else "".
If one row lists several serial numbers, return one entry per serial number with the same material. Skip headers, totals, page numbers and footers. Read every character exactly; never correct or invent numbers. A batch / lot number is NOT a serial number.
Return ONLY JSON: {"rows":[{"material":"","serial":"","qty":null,"desc":""}]}
